jobs.title: Physics Tutor in Tulsa
jobs.description:
BuffTutor is a network of experienced and passionate tutors who provide academic assistance to college & high school students. We are always hiring dedicated tutors; if you love teaching, join us!
RESPONSIBILITIES:

•
Provide 1-on-1 in-person tutoring to students attending universities or high schools in Tulsa such as University of Tulsa.

•
Provide online tutoring to students located throughout the country (if desired).

•
Assist students with Physics topics

• Classical mechanics: Kinematics, dynamics, forces, momentum, energy
,• Thermodynamics: Heat, temperature, ideal gases, laws of thermodynamics
,• Electricity and magnetism: Charges, fields, potential, circuits, induction
,• Waves and optics: Wave characteristics, sound, geometric/physical optics
,• Relativity and modern physics: Time dilation, length contraction, quantum basics
,• Nuclear physics: Radioactivity, fission, fusion, and atomic structures

BENEFITS:
• Set your own rate.
• In-person & online tutoring available; meet wherever works for you.
• Set your own schedule; meet whenever works for you.
• Work with as many (or as few) students as you would like to.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Have at least a 3.0 or better major GPA (out of 4.0).
• Have earned a B or better in the courses you wish to tutor.
• Have at least one year (or two semesters) of experience as a tutor, teacher, teaching/learning assistant or instructor.
• Have excellent communication skills and you must be fluent in the language that you teach in. Foreign Language tutors must be fluent in the Foreign Language they wish to tutor.

ABOUT BUFFTUTOR:
BuffTutor is dedicated to connecting students with intelligent and experienced tutors. We primarily focus on university level tutoring, but also work with high school and middle school students. More than just another tutor list, we prioritize the academic needs of our students while also treating our tutors with dignity and respect:
• We have some of the strictest eligibility criteria and challenging proficiency exams. Only the best can join our network!
• Tutors can set their own schedule. Our motto is quality is more important than quantity. Take on one student but be the best tutor for that student!
• Tutors can set their own rate. Earn what you are worth!
• We review student evaluations to help us keep the best tutor in our network.
BuffTutor was founded in 2009 and since then we have helped thousands of students and parents connect with affordable and passionate educators!
Please note that tutors are independent contractors, not employees. All applicants must already have work permissions; applicants who are students must be able to work an off-campus position. We do not sponsor individuals and we cannot work with F-1 or J-1 international students

jobs.description:
Posting number: Instr., Elec., & Cntrl Spclst

Department: Public Works and Utilities

Division: PWU Wastewater Treatment

Job classification: Instrumentation, Electrical & Control Specialist (Water Production)

Posting type: Open & Promotional

Categories: Public Works, Waste Management, Water Treatment, Water Agency, Wastewater, Utilities

Summary

This position performs skilled, technical work installing, operating, maintaining, and repairing electrical, instrumentation, control, and communication systems used in City of Wichita wastewater treatment plants, lift stations, force mains, and reuse facilities. Employees troubleshoot complex electrical and control issues, service PLC and SCADA components, calibrate meters and instruments, and support safe, reliable operation of critical wastewater infrastructure. Work varies by assignment and competency level, with opportunities to advance through four progression levels as additional skills and training are achieved. Duties are performed under the direction of a supervisor and may involve working near high-voltage equipment, in confined spaces, outdoors, and at varying facility locations.
Work location may vary between treatment plants

Workdays and Hours - Monday - Friday 7:00am - 3:30pm

Bargaining Unit: Service Employee's International (SEIU)

Employees within the department or division shall be given first consideration

Posting may close at any time

Examples of duties
• Installs, maintains, repairs, and adjusts electric motors, switches, wiring, fuses, and transformers.
• Troubleshooting 4–20 mA DC instrumentation signals and 240 V AC, 3-phase, 120/208 V, and 277/480 V electrical systems.
• Uses electrical testing devices to diagnose and resolve problems in electrical systems and equipment.
• Installs, inspects, analyzes, maintains, and repairs various types of electrical equipment and electronic control systems, including programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) components.
• Calibrates electronic meters and instruments.
• Perform required quality control and maintenance for on-line instrumentation.
• Troubleshoot communications and instrumentation problems.
• May work near high voltage electrical equipment.

• Coordinates and inspects installations and repairs by contractors.
• Completion of work assignments will require the operation of a vehicle.
• More complex work assignments will be required as employees attain higher levels of competency.
• The examples of work performed are not intended to be all-inclusive.

Qualifications
• Knowledge of the methods, tools, and materials used in electrical, electronic, and related mechanical repair work.
• Knowledge in the use of electrical testing devices.
• Considerable knowledge of occupational hazards and necessary safety precautions
• Knowledge of the standard computer keyboard configurations and ability to access, interpret, and record information using a video display terminal and electronic keyboard
• Ability to read and interpret drawings, blueprints, and specifications
• Ability to legibly maintain written and electronic records
• Ability to use the tools and apparatus common to the electrical trade area
• Ability to bend, twist, turn, pull, and stretch on a daily basis as required to perform electrical repair work, possibly in confined areas such as a closet
• Ability to carry, set up, and climb a 20 foot extension ladder on a daily basis
• Ability to climb stairs and ladders and/or work from lifts at heights up to 45 feet
• Ability to work in permitted and unpermitted confined spaces
• Ability to remove and carry an electric motor or similar equipment weighing up to 50 pounds
• Ability to push and/or pull a machine or hand truck

This is a Grant Funded role.

The Hardesty Center for Clinical Research and Neuroscience seeks a full-time Research Assistant to support a portfolio of interventional clinical trials. The position combines participant recruitment with hands-on clinical research coordination, including conducting study visits, administering clinical assessments, and supporting study drug administration and safety monitoring for enrolled participants.

Duties
• Assist with participant recruitment and screening, including community and clinic outreach, telephone and in-person screening, and eligibility determination.

• Build and maintain rapport with participants to support engagement and retention throughout the study period.
• Accurately document study visit data in source documents and electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
• Maintain compliance with study protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements.
• Assist with regulatory documentation and maintenance of study files.
• Assist with activities across multiple concurrent studies and protocols.
• Work as a team member within the OSU Biomedical Imaging Center and an 'extended team' member in the labs of research faculty with which the Simmons Lab is affiliated.

• Bachelor's
• Degree in psychology, public health, biology, nursing, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience (degree must be conferred on or before agreed upon start date)

Skills, Proficiencies, and/or Knowledge:
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to build trust and rapport with research participants.
• Ability to work with diverse participant populations in a nonjudgmental, patient-centered manner.
• Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and organizational skills.
• Ability to manage multiple studies and protocols simultaneously and to prioritize competing deadlines.
• Proficiency with standard office and data entry software.
Preferred Qualifications
• Prior experience in clinical research, healthcare, or human subjects research.
• Experience with electronic data capture systems, such as REDCap.
• Experience collecting vital signs.
• Phlebotomy experience or certification; training and certification are available to candidates without prior experience.
• Prior experience working with participants with substance use disorders or other behavioral health conditions.
• Experience with participant recruitment and retention in longitudinal or interventional studies.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
A top client of ours out of the Midwest is looking to add a Junior Data Analyst / SQL Developer to their team to support database operations, data validation, and onboarding processes within a healthcare data environment. This role is ideal for an early-career professional with a foundational understanding of relational databases, SQL scripting, and data analysis who is eager to develop their technical skills.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with Oracle or PostgreSQL databases, understanding data relationships, and troubleshooting data integrity issues. This individual will play an important role in reviewing SQL scripts, validating data onboarding activities, and ensuring accuracy and consistency across interconnected database systems.

This role is contract and remote, not open to C2C.

Key Responsibilities
• Review, analyze, and validate SQL scripts and database processes to ensure accurate data onboarding and integration.
• Execute testing procedures to verify that data onboarding activities have been completed correctly and meet established requirements.
• Identify data discrepancies, errors, or inconsistencies and collaborate with onboarding teams to resolve issues.
• Investigate complex data relationships, including identifying why records may be incorrectly linked or associated across systems.
• Write and execute SQL queries to retrieve, analyze, validate, and troubleshoot data across multiple database tables and systems.
• Review existing stored procedures, SQL scripts, and database logic to understand functionality and identify potential issues.
• Develop an understanding of relational database structures, primary and foreign keys, table relationships, and data dependencies.
• Support data integrity investigations and assist with developing SQL-based solutions to correct or reconcile data issues.
• Learn and become proficient in established database tables, data structures, and internal processes.
• Follow documented procedures and standardized playbooks to support consistent and repeatable data validation activities.
• Collaborate with technical teams to troubleshoot database issues and improve data quality and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications
• 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, database development, database administration, or a related technical role.
• Hands-on experience writing and executing SQL queries, preferably using Oracle SQL or PostgreSQL.
• Foundational understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS), including database structures and relationships.
• Knowledge of primary keys, foreign keys, joins, and how data is connected across multiple tables.
• Ability to query, retrieve, and analyze data from multiple tables or database systems.
• Experience reviewing SQL scripts, troubleshooting queries, and identifying data inconsistencies.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate data relationships and identify root causes.
• High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional technical teams.
• Willingness to learn new database environments, business processes, and established technical procedures.

jobs.description:
This role is for one of our clients

Compensation: $90-$140 per hour

Employment Type: Contract (Independent Contractor)
Location: Remote (United States)
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote, Flexible Schedule
Job Overview

We are seeking highly experienced PhD Physicists and senior research professionals to contribute their scientific expertise to the development, evaluation, and advancement of next-generation Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.

In this role, you will work alongside leading AI researchers to assess how advanced AI models understand and reason about complex physics concepts and real-world scientific problems. You will leverage your research experience and specialized domain knowledge to evaluate physics-related tasks, develop rigorous problem specifications, create reference solutions, and design challenging benchmarks that measure the scientific reasoning capabilities of AI systems.

The ideal candidate will be an established physicist with a strong academic or research background, deep specialization in at least one area of physics, and hands-on experience using large language models (LLMs).
Key Responsibilities
• Expert Evaluation: Review physics-related tasks and AI-generated outputs for scientific accuracy, logical consistency, and mathematical rigor.
• Identify flawed derivations, unjustified assumptions, inappropriate approximations, dimensional inconsistencies, and errors in boundary or limiting cases.
• Problem Design: Develop precise, research-level physics problem statements and detailed specifications that reflect real-world scientific challenges.
• Reference Solutions: Create rigorous reference solutions, demonstrating correct scientific reasoning, mathematical derivations, and appropriate methodologies.
• Benchmark Development: Design complex physics problems and evaluation datasets within your area of specialization to assess and improve AI model performance.
• Scientific Assessment: Evaluate AI-generated reasoning and distinguish scientifically valid arguments from responses that appear convincing but contain conceptual or mathematical errors.
• Research Collaboration: Work with AI researchers and subject matter experts across related disciplines to establish clear evaluation standards and measurable quality criteria.
• Feedback & Calibration: Translate specialized scientific knowledge and expert judgment into structured feedback and evaluation frameworks that improve AI reasoning capabilities.
Required Qualifications
• PhD in Physics, Astrophysics, Applied Physics, or a closely related discipline.
• Senior-level academic or research experience, such as:
• Faculty appointment at a recognized university.
• Principal Investigator (PI).
• Staff Scientist or Senior Scientist.
• Equivalent senior research position at a university, national laboratory, or established research organization.
• Deep specialization in at least one of the following physics domains:
• Condensed Matter Physics.
• High-Energy Physics / Particle Physics.
• Astrophysics and Cosmology.
• Atomic, Molecular, and Optical (AMO) Physics.
• Quantum Physics.
• Statistical Physics.
• Computational Physics.
• Applied Physics.
• Strong peer-reviewed research publication record.
• Recognition through competitive research fellowships, academic awards, grants, or other scientific achievements is an added advantage.
• Hands-on experience using Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI tools in research or scientific workflows.
• Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated scientific arguments, mathematical derivations, and technical explanations.
• Excellent written communication skills with the ability to develop precise problem statements and structured technical feedback.
• Must be currently based in the United States.
Contract & Payment Terms
• Engagement will be on an independent contractor basis.
• The position is fully remote and offers flexibility to complete assignments according to your own schedule and project requirements.

McElroy is looking for a Test Engineer with knowledge and experience to develop test plans, procedures, and methods for complex machines. The successful test engineer will be collaborative in work style with the ability to work with a variety of departments. This position creates and executes test procedures to verify that the product’s mechanical, electrical power, hydraulic, and control systems meet specifications while analyzing and presenting test results and data to the design teams to ensure the verification and validation of all product requirements.

• Evaluate test methods and equipment for the simulation of various mechanical and environmental conditions.
• Generate test plans, procedures, and work instructions from product specifications.

Install, maintain, and troubleshoot instrumentation and electrical systems, including PLCs, SCADA, sensors, motors, control panels, and HMI screens.

Perform routine inspections and preventive maintenance on electrical and instrumentation equipment.

Calibrate and configure instrumentation devices to ensure accurate readings and control.

• System Monitoring and Troubleshooting:

Monitor the performance of electrical and instrumentation systems to identify potential issues.

Diagnose and repair faults in electrical circuits, control systems, SCADA, HMI screens, and instrumentation devices.

Utilize diagnostic tools and software to pinpoint and resolve equipment malfunctions.

• Safety and Compliance:

Adhere to all safety protocols and regulations to prevent accidents and ensure a safe working environment.

Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations regarding electrical and instrumentation systems.

Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, calibrations, and repairs.

• Installation and Upgrades

Assist in the installation and commissioning of new electrical and instrumentation systems.

Recommend and implement upgrades to improve system performance and reliability.

Collaborate with engineering and maintenance teams on equipment modifications and improvements.

• Documentation and Reporting:

Maintain detailed records of all instrumentation and electrical work, including maintenance logs, calibration reports, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.

Generate reports on system performance, maintenance activities, and equipment status.

Ensure documentation is up-to-date and accessible for reference and compliance audits.

• Automation and Control Systems:

Work with automation systems to optimize and maintain manufacturing processes.

Configure and program PLCs and other automation controllers to enhance system performance.

• Team Collaboration:

Work closely with other maintenance personnel, engineers, and production staff to coordinate activities and minimize production interruptions.

Provide training and support to junior technicians and apprentices.

Participate in cross-functional teams to address complex technical issues and improve overall plant performance.

Qualifications

Associate degree or technical certification in instrumentation, electrical engineering, or a related field is preferred.

Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in instrumentation and electrical maintenance, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

Strong knowledge of PLCs, SCADA, DCS, HMI systems, automation, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and industrial control networks.

Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and technical manuals.

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in AMO Physics
jobs.description:
The William H. Miller III Department of Physics and Astronomy of the Johns Hopkins University invites applications for a faculty appointment as Assistant Professor in experimental atomic, molecular, and optical (AMO) physics.


The areas of interest include quantum information and sensing, quantum optics and metrology, quantum simulation and many-body physics, precision measurements and searches for physics beyond the Standard Model, and related work in fields closely allied with AMO physics. The successful candidate will be expected to maintain an active research program and to teach at both the undergraduate and graduate levels.
